input.query: WITH p AS (SELECT 'n' per, * FROM normal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_traces), sv AS (SELECT per, trace_id, span_id, service_name, span_name, duration FROM p WHERE attr_span_kind='Server'), ch AS (SELECT per, parent_span_id pid, sum(duration) cd, count(*) cn FROM p WHERE attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT service_name, avg(CASE WHEN per='n' THEN duration END)/1e6 n_srv, avg(CASE WHEN per='a' THEN duration END)/1e6 a_srv, avg(CASE WHEN per='n' THEN duration-coalesce(cd,0) END)/1e6 n_self, avg(CASE WHEN per='a' THEN duration-coalesce(cd,0) END)/1e6 a_self, count(CASE WHEN per='a' THEN 1 END) a_n FROM sv LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.per=sv.per AND ch.pid=sv.span_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT 'n' per, * FROM normal_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'a', * FROM abnormal_traces), sv AS (SELECT per, span_id, service_name, duration FROM p WHERE attr_span_kind='Server'), ch AS (SELECT per, parent_span_id pid, sum(duration) cd FROM p WHERE attr_span_kind='Client' GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT sv.service_name, round(avg(CASE WHEN sv.per='n' THEN sv.duration END)/1e6,1) n_srv, round(avg(CASE WHEN sv.per='a' THEN sv.duration END)/1e6,1) a_srv, round(avg(CASE WHEN sv.per='n' THEN sv.duration-coalesce(ch.cd,0) END)/1e6,1) n_self, round(avg(CASE WHEN sv.per='a' THEN sv.duration-coalesce(ch.cd,0) END)/1e6,1) a_self, count(CASE WHEN sv.per='a' THEN 1 END) a_n FROM sv LEFT JOIN ch ON ch.per=sv.per AND ch.pid=sv.span_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
